_comment: The carcass of a small cell: a steel can, the guts, a little plastic. Three draws,
because a battery is a small object and a pile of scrap out of one would read as
NO BATTERY IN THIS POOL, deliberately, which is the whole point of the chain. The
knowledge is declared at the top level instead, where it is granted WITHOUT the pool
having to draw the thing it teaches - a pool marked `teaches: true` grants the
fragment for whatever item it drew, so saying it that way would have handed back a
live battery for tearing up a dead one.
